mapper.select: SELECT e.expense_id AS expenseId, e.amount AS amount, e.discount_amount AS discountAmount, e.payment_date AS paymentDate, COALESCE(m.merchant_name, e.merchant_name) AS merchantName, COALESCE(p.category_id, c.category_id) AS groupCategoryId, COALESCE(p.category_name, c.category_name) AS groupCategoryName, b.benefit_name AS benefitName, cd.card_name AS cardName FROM expense e JOIN category c ON c.category_id = e.category_id LEFT JOIN category p ON p.category_id = c.parent_category_id LEFT JOIN merchant m ON m.merchant_id = e.merchant_id LEFT JOIN benefit b ON b.benefit_id = e.applied_benefit_id JOIN user_card uc ON uc.user_card_id = e.user_card_id JOIN card cd ON cd.card_id = uc.card_id WHERE e.member_id = #{memberId} AND e.payment_status = 'APPROVED' AND e.discount_amount > 0 AND DATE_FORMAT(e.payment_date, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} ORDER BY e.payment_date DESC, e.expense_id DESC
